mapper.select: SELECT * FROM column_mappings ORDER BY import_type
SELECT * FROM column_mappings WHERE import_type = #{importType} AND is_default = TRUE LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO column_mappings (import_type, name, mapping_json, is_default) VALUES (#{importType}, #{name}, #{mappingJson}, COALESCE(#{isDefault}, FALSE))
mapper.update: UPDATE column_mappings SET import_type=#{importType}, name=#{name}, mapping_json=#{mappingJson}, is_default=#{isDefault} WHERE id=#{id}
